title: H4023 (123rd General Assembly): Weapons on school property

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): The provisions contained in this subsection related to any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a college, university, technical college, or other post-secondary institution do not apply to a person who is authorized to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to Article 4, Chapter 31, Title 23.
